e2e.title: End-to-End Encryption
e2e.desc: ChaCha20-Poly1305 + X25519 ECDH, messages encrypted throughout transmission

local.title: Local Inference
local.desc: Based on llama.cpp, GPU accelerated, zero network latency

multimodal.desc: Supports image understanding and audio transcription, vision + audio dual modality

thinking.title: Thinking Mode
thinking.desc: Supports thinkingLevel configuration, simulates deep reasoning

compatibility.title: API Compatibility
compatibility.desc: This API is fully compatible with Google Gemini API format. Existing Gemini clients only need to change the base URL to connect.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.generateDesc: Core interface for generating text content. Supports plain text, multimodal input, and tool calling.

generateContent.desc: Core interface for generating text content
generateContent.modelDesc: Model name, supports gemini-3-pro-preview or gemini-3-flash-preview
generateContent.contentsDesc: Conversation content array, each element contains role and parts
generateContent.generationConfigDesc: Generation config, includes maxOutputTokens, temperature, thinkingConfig, etc.
generateContent.toolConfigDesc: Tool calling config, mode can be AUTO/ANY/NONE

thinking.title: Thinking Mode (thinkingConfig)
thinking.desc: Enable deep reasoning, let the model think before answering

info.title: Thinking Mode Description
info.desc: Thinking mode simulates Gemini 3's thinking feature through prompt engineering. The model will first reason in <thinking> tags, then give the answer in <answer> tags.

tools.title: Tool Calling (Function Calling)
tools.desc: Let the model call external functions, supports parallel calling
tools.auto: Model automatically decides whether to call tools (default)
tools.any: Force tool calling, no plain text returned
tools.noneMode: Disable tool calling, only return text

multimodal.title: Trimodal Support
multimodal.desc: Supports text, image understanding and audio transcription

text.desc:

Supports thinking deep reasoning

image.title: Image Understanding
image.desc:

Via Vision mmproj (570MB)

audio.title: Audio Transcription
audio.desc:
Supports WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG

audioFormat.title: Audio Format Requirements
audioFormat.desc: Recommended 16kHz mono WAV format for best results. Supported formats: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, WebM. Audio files need to be Base64 encoded and passed to inlineData.data field.

platformSupport.title: Platform Support (2025-01)
platformSupport.macos: macOS (Apple Silicon): Metal GPU acceleration, full support
platformSupport.ubuntu: Ubuntu x86_64 (CUDA): NVIDIA GPU acceleration, full support (includes audio transcription fix)
platformSupport.linux: Linux x86_64 (CPU): Pure CPU inference, slower
platformSupport.note: Audio transcription tested on Ubuntu 22.04 + NVIDIA RTX 4090.

thoughtSignature.title: Thought Signature
thoughtSignature.desc: AI's "working memory", enables true stateful reasoning

concept.title: Core Concept
concept.desc: Traditional LLMs are like geniuses with "short-term memory loss", having to re-read history every conversation. Thought Signature enables true working memory through KV Cache persistence.

e2eEncryption.title: End-to-End Encrypted Communication
e2eEncryption.desc: Ensure absolute privacy of AI conversations

why.title: Why Encryption?
why.desc: Even with local inference, messages can still be intercepted during transmission. End-to-end encryption ensures only you and the AI can read the conversation. LingKong is designed based on Signal Protocol, providing forward secrecy and key rotation protection.

kem.title: KEM Key Encapsulation
kem.desc: Non-interactive key establishment, no multi-round handshake needed

chacha.title: ChaCha20-Poly1305
chacha.desc: AEAD authenticated encryption, confidentiality + integrity guarantee

ed25519.title: Ed25519 Signature
ed25519.desc: Digital signature verifies message authenticity, tamper-proof

forward.title: Forward Secrecy
forward.desc: Each request uses ephemeral keys, historical messages cannot be decrypted

cryptoApi.title: Crypto API Endpoints
cryptoApi.publicKey: Get server public key (for encrypting requests)

keyExchange.title: Key Exchange Flow
keyExchange.desc: Use LingKong Client SDK for end-to-end encrypted communication

messageEncryption.title: Encrypted Message Format
messageEncryption.desc: Encryption envelope structure for requests and responses

securityTip.title: Security Tip
securityTip.desc: Each message uses a unique ephemeral key pair (ephemeral_public), ensuring forward secrecy. Even if long-term keys are compromised, historical messages cannot be decrypted.

doubleRatchet.title: Double Ratchet Protocol (Optional)
doubleRatchet.desc: Enhanced forward secrecy for long-term sessions

useCase.title: Use Case
useCase.desc: For long-term sessions or high-security scenarios, you can use the double ratchet protocol. Each message triggers key rotation, providing stronger security.

tinybox_page.title: Tinybox DIY Guide - 6x RX 7900 XTX AI Workstation Build Guide
tinybox_page.subtitle: From Hardware Selection to Open Source Optimization, Build Your 6x RX 7900 XTX AI Monster

hardware.title: Hardware Selection & BOM
hardware.desc: We recommend the EPYC server platform for unmatched stability and PCIe bandwidth. Below is the full BOM list, total budget approx. ¥48,000 (~$6,700).

tips.storage_desc: Your existing Intel 480GB SSD is sufficient for Ubuntu + tinygrad. If running 70B models later, consider adding a 1TB NVMe SSD (~¥400).
tips.cooling_desc: Open bench frames offer the best airflow. Ensure spacing between GPUs and add extra case fans for airflow, critical for the 7900XTX.

step1.title: Physical Assembly
step1.desc:
Platform Setup: Install EPYC CPU and 8 RAM sticks on ROMED8-2T. Test post with 1 GPU direct.

Rack Mounting: Secure mobo to bottom of open bench. Mount 6 GPUs on top bar.

Risers: Connect 6 PCIe extension cables from mobo x16 slots to GPUs.

step2.title: Dual PSU Wiring (Important)
step2.desc: Use 2000W Main + 850W Secondary. Must use sync cable to start simultaneous.
